reimbursement_policies.evidence: Always bundled and not separately reimbursable when reported as a stand-alone service or with another service.

M3110 is not explicitly addressed. This policy does not adjudicate the musculoskeletal/connective-tissue inpatient pattern by DRG label or M-code, but it does impose line-item facility bundling rules that can affect related implant/connective-tissue supplies. Relevant connective tissue and implant HCPCS codes C1734, C1762, C1763, C1781, C1889, and L8699 are generally always bundled and not separately reimbursable on facility claims. California history shows delayed-implementation reimbursement for those codes; Indiana has no matching carve-out for them; Kansas has no stated exception.

state_specific_rules: California: delayed implementation history allows reimbursement for C1734/C1762/C1763/C1781/C1889/L8699 effective 10/01/2026
Indiana: no carve-out stated for these connective tissue or implant codes

recommended_action.description: Recommendation 1: For Commercial facility provider claims, bundle C1734, C1762, C1763, C1781, C1889, and L8699 whether billed as a "stand-alone service" or "with another service"; in California, preserve the delayed-implementation exception and reimburse C1734/C1762/C1763/C1781/C1889/L8699 effective 10/01/2026, while Indiana has no carve-out stated and Kansas has no state-specific exception stated. Apply to all states. Exempt: provider, state, federal contract requirements, California delayed implementation for C1734/C1762/C1763/C1781/C1889/L8699. Peer: Elevance external and internal both target C1734/C1762/C1763/C1781/L8699 for bundling in Commercial, with the internal policy adding the California delayed-implementation carve-out..
